definition.scope: Descriptive paired length sensitivity; no winner screening and no confirmatory hypothesis family

inputs.new: length_report_v1.json after OSwait0, PIDs dead and controlled SHA return

definition.units: 4 fixed configurations x16 fixed question IDs x3 lengths; same rendered input SHA required
definition.retention: All predefined configurations and IDs; failures/missing explicit, never zero-imputed
outputs: per-question paired scores, truncation, parse failure, output tokens, natural wall seconds
per-configuration-length count correct/16, truncated/16, parsefail/16; nonexclusive flags explicitly labelled
paired accuracy differences in percentage points and nominal question-cluster bootstrap 95% percentile intervals
total/mean/median/p90 natural wall seconds and output tokens, retaining per-question raw pairs

bootstrap.cluster: question ID; same resampled IDs across all configurations and lengths
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentile; descriptive nominal; fixed configuration panel, not seed-population inference

definition.interpretation: Length diagnostic is exploratory sensitivity, does not revise original512 scores, establish mechanism, or provide independent test-set replication
definition.execution: New estimates only via frozen immutable CPU spec/materials/environment/resources/preflight/experimentctl launch; rendering reads frozen outputs
